editorial:
Imagine waking up to find that the world has gone completely crazy and zombies are everywhere. That is exactly what happens to Tom Riley and Jackson Scott. You get to follow these two as they try to survive the chaos while figuring out how to stop the plague from taking over everything. It is not your typical scary movie because it mixes in a lot of humor and sci-fi elements. The vibe is lighthearted and goofy, making it feel more like a wild ride than a nightmare. You will find yourself rooting for these unlikely heroes as they bumble through the apocalypse.

What really works here is the chemistry between the leads and the fast pace that keeps you from getting bored. While the special effects are not the biggest budget you have ever seen, the funny dialogue and unexpected twists make up for it. If you love movies that do not take themselves too seriously, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final act, the characters discover the actual source of the zombie outbreak and race to shut it down. After a chaotic fight with the undead, they manage to trigger a cure that stops the virus from spreading further. The movie wraps up with a funny twist showing that not everyone is fully back to normal, leaving the door open for more trouble. It ends on a high note with the heroes surviving against all odds.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zany comedies and zombie flicks.
